notes: Standard Deduction Worksheet for Dependents, line 4b: the line 1 box count times $1,600 ($2,000 if single or head of household), reusing tax.us.2025.parameter.additional-standard-deduction v1 -- confirmed byte-identical to the worksheet's own line 4b amounts (P0 Sec. 7; Contract item 4), not a new parameter. Zero boxes publishes 0 regardless of filing status, which is why line 4c (4a + 4b) needs no separate 'born after January 1, 1961 and not blind, stop at 4a' branch: 4b is already 0 in exactly that case.
